In detail

This district covers Kolonos, Akadimia Platonos, Kolokynthou, Profitis Daniil and Sepolia, and has one of the most heavily and consistently documented problem patterns in Athens. Sepolia was the scene of a 2021 daylight shooting/execution at a cafe witnessed by a 15-year-old, prompting 2021 citizen patrols against open drug dealing in the area, and in October 2024 police arrested minors dealing drugs outside a primary school there. Kolonos has been repeatedly described in the press as a "new ghetto" (To Vima, 2024; Ta Nea, January 2026) in connection with organised drug dealing near Attika metro station, a gang stabbing, and a 2024 child-exploitation case. Akadimia Platonos was the subject of a 2020 "cry of anguish" report on neglect, balanced by 2024-2025 reporting on an archaeological-park regeneration project underway there. Profitis Daniil has no documented pattern in the sources checked. Given the multi-year, recurring and serious nature of the Sepolia and Kolonos incidents, day is rated yellow and night is rated red. Sources checked: To Vima; Antenna/enikos; Zougla; in.gr; MEGA TV; Ta Nea; Enikos/Athens Voice/KEDE.
